description: Recorded daily port calls (vessel arrivals) at one port by ship type, from IMF PortWatch (AIS-derived), for the most recent days. These are past calls, not a forward arrival or departure schedule, and the latest date lags real time. Choose this tool for: Recorded daily port calls at one port by ship type. Close alternatives on this server: logistics_imo_vessel_dossier (Ship particulars by IMO number: name, type, flag, MMSI); logistics_jet_a1_fuel_index (Daily US Gulf Coast kerosene-type jet fuel spot price). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

port.description: PortWatch port name, e.g. Rotterdam, Singapore
